title: Updated recommendations on measles post-exposure prophylaxis (NACI statement of February 13, 2025)
summary: NACI strongly recommends completing the routine 2-dose MMR schedule and that measles post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) be offered to people not expected to be immune. Infants under 6 months: immunoglobulin within 6 days; unvaccinated infants 6 to under 12 months: MMR within 72 hours or immunoglobulin within 6 days; pregnant people who are unvaccinated or seronegative: IVIg within 6 days; immunocompromised people 6 months and older are stratified by risk. Web-published June 4, 2025.

title: Summary of NACI statement of February 13, 2025: Updated recommendations on measles post-exposure prophylaxis
summary: Plain-language summary of the NACI statement on measles post-exposure prophylaxis. Routine MMR coverage above 95% is needed, and PEP should be offered to individuals not expected to have measles immunity.

title: Addendum to the updated recommendations on measles post-exposure prophylaxis
summary: NACI addendum (June 4, 2025) removing Table 6 (comparison of human immunoglobulin products) from the statement. Any available IVIg product may be used for measles PEP, including off-label use, to avoid delays.
